name: AI and LLM features
explanation: Adding AI features built on large language models, such as a chatbot, summaries, document Q&A or AI agents.
triggers: add a chatbot;ai chat;chat with ai;ask ai;ai summary;summarize with ai;answer questions about our docs;use chatgpt;ai that can take actions;claude api
requirements: Treat everything the model reads as untrusted, including user text, documents and web pages (prompt injection);Never run code, SQL or commands from model output without checking it;Give AI agents and tools the fewest permissions they need, and ask the user before risky actions;In retrieval (RAG), search only documents the current user is allowed to see;Keep secrets and other users' data out of prompts;Escape model output before showing it as HTML;Limit requests and tokens per user to control cost and abuse;Log prompts and tool calls for review, without storing sensitive data
done_when: Instructions hidden in a document cannot make the AI leak data or take actions;Users only get answers from data they are allowed to see
